documentation: Locked standard Corvlio prices plus a restricted live-only one-time test payment. Amounts are USD cents. No call blocking, suspension, automatic tier movement or per-call charges.

policy.businessDayDocumentation: Count Monday-Friday in UTC, starting after the first failed charge; no holiday calendar is defined by the agreement. Add excluded YYYY-MM-DD dates here if approved.
policy.lateFeeDocumentation: Disabled placeholder only. The agreement's legal maximum is unspecified; do not compute or collect late fees.
policy.manualOffboardingDocumentation: No retention deletion, number release, number hold, or recording export automation. Follow the separately approved manual offboarding process.
policy.nonBlankCallDocumentation: Completed Retell records or legacy completed lead captures with a real call ID, plus nonempty transcript, summary or caller issue. Distinct call IDs; contacted status is not call completion.
